title: Positive Semidefinite?
prompt:
Is the symmetric matrix

    [[-1, 1], [1, -3]]

positive semidefinite? Answer 1 for yes, 0 for no.
hint: 2×2 symmetric is PSD iff a ≥ 0, c ≥ 0, and ac − b² ≥ 0
recap: A symmetric 2×2 [[a, b], [b, c]] is positive semidefinite iff a ≥ 0, c ≥ 0 and ac − b^2 ≥ 0. PSD matrices are exactly the Hessians of convex quadratics.
